doc: Employers whose published candidate-AI policy forbids AI-drafted application material. scripts/jobs_sources.mjs aiPolicyFor() reads this; forge_edit_from_seed.mjs and jobs_cover_letter.mjs refuse to generate a resume or cover letter for a matching company. Zach drafts first; Claude may only review and refine his draft. Add a company here when its careers page publishes such a rule (Zach, 2026-11-16).

policies.allowed: Claude refines a resume or answer the candidate drafted first; interview prep and research.
policies.not_allowed: Claude writing the resume or application answers; Claude during take-homes or live interviews unless Anthropic says so.

generated_before_policy_known.note: Forge bundles generated before this rule was recorded. Do not submit them as written; Zach drafts his own resume and answers, then Claude may refine.
